svg.title: An 0402 footprint: the gap between the pads
svg.desc: Enlarged and drawn to scale. Left: the recommended 0402 footprint, two pads 0.6 mm long and 0.7 mm wide on a 1.0 mm pitch, leaving a 0.4 mm gap; the part's metal ends sit fully on the pads. Right: a footprint whose gap is 0.7 mm; the part's ends only just reach the pads, which is how tombstoning and head-in-pillow start.

g.text: Metal end barely on the pad
Enlarged and drawn to scale. Dimensions in mm.
Footprint from the table in PCB-DFA-029.
